title: Cross-Runner Verifier: Independent Confirmation for Critical Findings
goal: Before any critical or high finding is committed to the run report, a second independent runner or primitive sequence verifies the impact claim. Eliminates the false-positive class where a single runner's heuristic match is treated as proof.
scope: Add api/app/services/finding_verifier.py with verify_finding(finding, run, scope) -> VerifierVerdict. Picker is updated to route critical/high findings through verifier before persistence. Verifier chooses an independent check (different primitive sequence from the original) and runs it. Findings that fail verification get severity downgraded with a verifier_note.
generation_reason: Today, a runner that says 'admin compromise proven' because it saw 'Manage this server' in the body has no independent check. AI is trusting itself. Cross-runner verification is the canonical way to reach zero-false-positive on critical findings - one of the key differentiators against rule-based competitors.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Verifier service + picker integration only. Do NOT add new severities, do NOT change the existing severity scale, do NOT replace existing finding_chains heuristic.
constraints.verifier_independence: Verifier check MUST use a different code path than the originating runner. Same runner re-running is not independent verification.
constraints.no_block_low_severity: Verifier only runs on critical and high severity. Medium/low/info findings persist without extra verification step (cost control).

success_criteria: finding_verifier.verify_finding chooses an independent check based on finding kind (e.g. for 'admin compromise' it fetches a known admin-only endpoint with the captured session and asserts admin content present).
Critical/high findings that fail verification are persisted with severity downgraded one notch and a verifier_note explaining the discrepancy.
Critical/high findings that pass verification are persisted with verifier_verdict: confirmed.
Verifier failure (network issue, scope blocked) results in severity unchanged but verifier_verdict: inconclusive (not auto-downgrade).
Live test: 1 known-good critical finding on Gruyere verifies as confirmed. 1 contrived false-positive case verifies as failed and is downgraded.

acceptance_criteria: Critical findings carry verifier_verdict field after this task.
Verifier check uses a different code path than the originating runner.
No regression in finding persistence for medium/low/info severity.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
